notes:
New
• Cut Video: removes dead space, stutters and repeated takes, cleans up empty audio tracks, and gives you a clean base cut
• Fully Edit Video: the full creator edit; after Cut Video it builds on your cut instead of starting over
• Apply Changes: one clear button applies all your notes in Premiere, with Auto-apply on by default
• Delete Project: removes the Solis project; your original videos and Premiere project are never deleted
• Premiere is saved automatically after a verified Solis edit or revision (Settings › Premiere)

Improved
• Much less dead space: Solis now listens to the voice tracks only, so game audio no longer hides the pauses between sentences
• False starts are removed: "hello" … "hello everybody, welcome back" keeps the clean second take (the same word 10+ seconds later is left alone)
• Stutters like "I-I-I think" or "gonna gonna" are cleaned up; no cuts through words
• Sound effects only where something happens (an image pop, a reveal, a bleep); normal cuts get none
• Music is now clearly audible under your voice
• Empty audio tracks are left off the edit; a Discord or guest track keeps only the parts where someone talks
• Notes like "remove the SFX", "stop using so many SFX", "remove the first hello, keep the second one" and "move the facecam" now work
• Every edit passes a quality check before it's marked ready

Fixed
• Typing in Creative Direction no longer jumps to the project name
• A note Solis can't understand no longer blocks the others; it's marked "Needs clarification" with the reason
